dependencies.source_implementation_unblocks_after: satisfied by accepted C12 merge and this preregistration amendment

preregistration_amendment.scope: dependency hash-pin and exact C12 canonical field inventory only

design_clarification_before_evaluation.timing: two uncommitted contract/ledger drafts existed; no test, runner, experiment, artifact, metric, or threshold result had been executed or observed

state_hashes.active_state_hash: canonical config, immutable records, and explicit active flags only; audit rows and delivery counters excluded
state_hashes.audit_chain_hash: append-only hash chain over strict audit rows; must advance on add, exact redelivery, rejection, deactivate, and restore
state_hashes.restore_rule: restore returns active_state_hash, fixed-time summary, probability, decision, and citations exactly; audit_chain_hash must not rewind

metric_definitions.prediction_change: absolute positive_probability delta at the same fixed snapshot time
metric_definitions.cross_talk_opportunity: one directed relation-free intervention on entity A paired with one non-target entity B hypothesis snapshot
metric_definitions.cross_talk_event: absolute B probability delta greater than 1e-12 or any change to B canonical summary, active citations, or active-state projection
metric_definitions.evidence_misassignment_rate: E1 rows whose entity_key differs from the explicit oracle entity_slot / all E1 evidence rows eligible for assignment
metric_definitions.oracle_entity_coverage: E1 eligible sparks with a nonempty assigned entity_key / all E1 eligible sparks
metric_definitions.scientific_gap: E0 cross_talk point estimate minus E1 cross_talk point estimate; paired bootstrap interval is reported but is not an engineering gate

descendant_semantics.effective_active: record active flag and every transitive parent_evidence_id active
descendant_semantics.summary_and_decision: exclude records that are not effectively active
descendant_semantics.restore: reactivating the immutable ancestor automatically restores eligible descendants without rewriting them
descendant_semantics.citation_resolution: inactive records remain resolvable; unknown parent, self-parent, and cycles fail closed

contract_fields.correlation_group: nullable immutable canonical value; null uses a unique evidence-ID group for summary discounting; null-to-value and value-to-null redelivery are identity mutations

fixture_generator.canonical_document: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true, separators comma/colon, fields schema_version, seed, episodes

canonical_shape.serialization: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); all content is ASCII; hash the UTF-8 bytes

fixture_generator.target_entity: object-a when (episode_index + seed) modulo 2 is zero, otherwise object-b
fixture_generator.target_hypothesis: state-left when (floor(episode_index / 2) + seed) modulo 2 is zero, otherwise state-right

events.add_primary: event/observed offset 0; source-primary; support 1.0; group cg:{seed}:{episode_index:02d}:support
events.add_correlated_variant: event/observed offset 1; source-correlated; support 1.0; same support group
events.late_exact_redelivery: event offset 2; byte-exact redelivery of add_primary with its original observed time

g0_decision.winner: eligible hypothesis with maximum positive_probability; lexicographically smallest hypothesis_id on an exact tie
g0_decision.both_below_or_no_eligible: abstain with no winner and empty citations
g0_decision.both_eligible: select exactly one winner because budget is one
g0_decision.citations: sorted effectively-active support and contradict evidence IDs from the winner summary; neutral IDs remain traceable but are not decision citations

identity.immutable_payload: the exact strict canonical EvidenceRecord bytes, including schema_version, metadata, correlation null/value, time, strength, polarity, both parent lists, entity, hypothesis, source, and evidence_id
identity.evidence_id: ev- plus full sha256 of canonical JSON array [schema_version, spark.evidence_id, hypothesis_id, polarity]
identity.binding_id: bind- plus full sha256 of canonical JSON array [schema_version, parent_spark_id, entity_hint, entity_slot, assignment_status]
identity.multi_hypothesis_or_polarity: each distinct hypothesis/polarity tuple receives its deterministic ID; exact tuple redelivery receives the same ID

rejection_envelope_hash.purpose: deterministic audit hash even when the attempted payload is non-JSON or nonfinite
rejection_envelope_hash.hash: sha256 of strict canonical JSON envelope; raw invalid values and repr output are never hashed
rejection_envelope_hash.state_effect: rejection advances only audit_chain_hash; active_state_hash is unchanged

slot_metric.population: assigned rows only for matching; unassigned and uncertain rows are excluded and reported separately
slot_metric.weight: integer contingency count for predicted_slot and oracle_entity
slot_metric.rectangular: pad the smaller sorted side with zero-weight dummy labels
slot_metric.tie_break: lexicographically smallest sorted predicted-slot to oracle-entity mapping among maximum-weight mappings
slot_metric.matched_accuracy: matched assigned rows / all assigned rows, or 0.0 when there are no assigned rows
slot_metric.assigned_coverage: assigned eligible rows / all eligible rows
slot_metric.unassigned_rate: unassigned eligible rows / all eligible rows
slot_metric.uncertain_rate: uncertain eligible rows / all eligible rows
slot_metric.slot_switch_rate: for consecutive assigned observations of the same oracle entity, mapped-slot changes / all such consecutive assigned pairs; 0.0 when denominator is zero
slot_metric.pure_rename: renaming predicted slots bijectively must leave every metric unchanged

stop_conditions: production entity assignment depends on evaluator truth
evidence citation cannot be resolved, removed, restored, or traced
frozen input, core, budget, evaluator, or seed list differs between E0 and E1
test results change a threshold or mapping
E0, E1, or E2 rows are merged
E2 implementation or evaluation begins before E1 freeze
